title: The app is stuck on an old version
content:
Morechard updates itself automatically in the background, but a new version only takes effect the next time you fully close and reopen the app — a simple in-app refresh isn't enough while it's already running.

Try this: close the app completely (swipe it away from your recent apps, or close the browser tab entirely) and reopen it. On the web, a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows, Cmd+Shift+R on Mac) works too.

title: A chore I created isn't showing up on my child's dashboard
content:
A few things can explain this — check these first:

  • Wrong day. Recurring chores only appear on the days they're scheduled (e.g. a "school days" chore won't show on a Saturday).
  • Assigned to a different child. Double-check who the chore is assigned to in Settings.
  • It's overdue. A one-off chore past its due date moves into a separate overdue section rather than the main list.
  • It was archived. An archived chore stops appearing entirely until restored.

If none of these explain it, contact support and we'll check the assignment on our end.

title: The app isn't working — it says there's no connection
content:
Morechard needs an internet connection for anything that reads or writes your family's data (approving chores, checking balances, etc.) — actions don't currently queue up to sync automatically once you're back online, so if something fails while you're offline, you'll need to try it again once your connection is back.

The app itself (the screens and navigation) will still open without a connection, since that part is cached on your device — it's specifically actions that need a live connection to work.

title: Face ID or fingerprint login keeps asking for my PIN instead
content:
This usually means your device's saved biometric sign-in has been reset or invalidated — for example if you cleared your browser data, reinstalled the app, or changed your device passcode. Your account itself is fine — this only affects the device-level shortcut.

Use your PIN to get back in, then re-register biometrics from Settings if the option is available on your device. If it keeps happening, contact support.

title: My invite link says it's expired or already used
content:
Invite codes (for a co-parent or a child joining a device) are valid for 72 hours and can only be redeemed once. If you see this message, the code has either timed out or someone already used it to link a device.

The fix is simple: go back to the parent dashboard and generate a fresh code, then use that one instead. Sign-in links sent by email work the same way — request a new one if an old one has expired.

title: I can't find the Approve button for a chore
content:
Two common explanations:

  • The chore is set to Skip Approval. If you turned this on when creating it, it pays out automatically the moment your child marks it done — there's nothing to approve, by design.
  • Your child hasn't marked it done yet. A chore only needs your approval after your child has submitted it. If it's still sitting as in-progress on their end, there's nothing for you to approve yet.

Chores actually awaiting your review show up together on your dashboard — if you expect one there and don't see it, check which of the above applies.
